questions.text:
In triangle \(ABC\), \(a=7\), \(b=14\), and \(A=30^\circ\).  
   Without solving the whole triangle, find the two possible values of \(B-C\).
Point \(B\) is \(100\) miles from point \(A\) at bearing \(N60^\circ E\). A pilot mistakenly flies due east from \(A\) for \(50\) miles. How far is the pilot from \(B\)?

questions.text: Let $x_k$ be the $x$-coordinate of the terminal point determined by the real number $t_k = \frac{k\pi}{8}$. Mentally evaluate the product $x_1 x_2 x_3 x_5 x_6 x_7$.
